title.description: One line that names the work chosen; it becomes the title of the pull request.

request.description: The work chosen, written as a request a person could have typed: what is to be done and what done looks like.

rationale.description: Why this comes before everything else that is open, with what you checked.

blockers.description: Open work that stands in the way of the priority and that this run can do, the most pressing first.

stops.description: What stands in the way and only a person can lift, each written as a question to that person, with the choices and the one you recommend. Empty where there is none.

question.description: What you ask the person to decide, in one sentence.

problem.description: What stands in the way: what happened or what is missing, in words a person who was not there can follow.

tried.description: What you looked at or tried before calling this a stop, and why no work of the run settles it.

means.description: What it means for the work: what cannot be done, or cannot be trusted, until it is lifted.

options.description: The choices the person has, at least two, each a sentence that says what it leads to.

recommended.description: The choice you recommend, word for word as it stands among the options, chosen by the bar your task gives for recommendations.

why.description: Why that one: which point of the bar decides it, what it costs and what it risks.
